query: In a group thread called Field Crew, someone sent a bunch of pictures. Let's swipe the front one to the left to see the one behind it, then swipe again. Keep the composer exactly where it is.

candidates.title: Swipe through stacked attachments in a chat
candidates.moves: The top attachment moves sideways across the card edges. Independently offset artwork beneath it becomes the next top attachment.
candidates.staysFixed: Conversation header, message copy, composer and stack anchor stay in place.

candidates.title: Photos slide inside a fixed place card
candidates.moves: A single horizontal strip carries all photos left together. The viewport clips both edges.
candidates.staysFixed: The place name, open status, rating, action controls, tabs, address and viewport stay fixed.
